content.purpose: Explains how endpoint resources provide stable hosts for online predictions and how their lifecycle is managed.
content.whenToUse: Use it when planning a region-scoped endpoint operation or diagnosing permission, quota, or resource-busy issues.
content.outputs: It provides gcloud command examples, regional scope requirements, confirmation guidance, and troubleshooting advice.
